crossRefs.note: Receive my instruction rather than silver, knowledge rather than choice gold.
For her good profit is better than getting silver, and her return is better than fine gold.
For wisdom is a defense, even as money is a defense; but the excellency of knowledge is that wisdom preserves the life…

translations.web: My fruit is better than gold, yes, than fine gold, my yield than choice silver.
translations.bsb: My fruit is better than gold, pure gold, and my harvest surpasses choice silver.
translations.kjv: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; and my revenue than choice silver.
translations.asv: My fruit is better than gold, yea, than fine gold; And my revenue than choice silver.
